product.description: A feature allowing players to customize their in-game avatars by changing heads, body parts, skins, clothing, and accessories.

product.description: Digital passes that grant holders access to beta testing and exclusive in-game perks.

product.name: Referral Program
product.description: A system where players complete quests and invite friends to earn tokens and unlock unique items.
